主要内容: Nicholas Financial Inc held its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on August 13, 2015. The voting results for the election of directors were as follows: Scott Fink received 2,942,979 votes, with 81,119 withheld and 2,640,726 broker non-votes. Robin Hastings received 2,956,299 votes, with 67,799 withheld and 2,640,726 broker non-votes. Ralph Finkenbrink, Kevin Bates, and Stephen Bragin continued as directors after the meeting.
